name: Improved Eclipse of Fury raises the effectiveness of Eclipse of Fury by 40% (#2399)
contract: Improved Eclipse of Fury 704793 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32) reads "Increases the effectiveness of Eclipse of Fury by $s1%". Its effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue 8 = SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS, EffectBasePoints 39 with DieSides 1 resolving to 40, and EffectSpellClassMask word0 0x200, which is the SpellFamilyFlags word0 of every Eclipse of Fury rank 570217..570221 (SpellFamilyName 32). Eclipse of Fury's effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_344 (an Ascension aura, EffectBasePoints -36 on rank 1, -141 on rank 5). Native path only: SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue calls Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers, which applies SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS then the per-index op through Player::ApplySpellMod, where an ADD_PCT_MODIFIER adds 40/100 to the multiplier (totalmul 1.4) for any op other than DAMAGE and DOT. The metric spell_effect_value returns exactly SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue(player), the value the aura effect is built from, so the talented amount over the untalented amount is 1.4 up to int32 truncation of the product (rank 1 -36*1.4 = -50.4 truncates to -50, ratio 1.389; larger magnitudes approach 1.4), hence the 1.38..1.42 window. No module hook touches these ranks (the only Eclipse of Fury entries in module data are the mana-cost table). The mana-cost helper 570243 is a separate spell and is not asserted. Both fixtures are the same race, class and level, so only the passive can move the ratio.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Learn Improved Eclipse of Fury on the talented fixture only
Eclipse of Fury rank 1 effect 0 without the talent
Rank 1 effect 0 is 40% larger with the talent
Eclipse of Fury rank 5 effect 0 without the talent
Rank 5 effect 0 is 40% larger with the talent
